key_idea: Always solving an applicable problem is optimal: a higher skill can never be overtaken by a lower one, since they move by at most 1 per step.
sketch: Scan the list once; if l <= s <= r then s++. Exchange/dominance argument: if two trajectories have s' >= s, after any problem s' >= s still holds (if only the lower one increments they were at least 1 apart). O(n). Pitfall: values up to 2e9 need 64-bit.
